name: Toledo Executive Airport climate observation station
notes: Representative station record; not basin-wide and precipitation contains missing/trace values.

name: Lucas County climate variability context
notes: County climate-series context; adjusted climate analysis is not identical to a station extreme.

name: Toledo-area NWS forecast and warning service area
notes: Forecast and warning service linkage; no current alert or hazard probability is asserted.

name: Maumee watershed runoff-connectivity interface
notes: Project-inferred hydrologic interface; the representative USGS gauge supports river observation only and does not establish watershed-wide runoff or a precipitation-frequency surface.

name: Maumee River at Waterville USGS gauge
notes: Daily mean discharge observation; gauge is not the whole watershed or floodplain.

name: Lower Maumee and tributary flood interface
notes: Represents runoff, river-stage, tributary, and floodplain interaction without a new flood footprint.

name: Regulatory flood-hazard mapping context
notes: FEMA regulatory mapping is distinct from observed flooding, forecast flooding, and future scenario change.

name: Urban stormwater pathway context
notes: Project-inferred developed drainage context; Atlas 14 supports site/grid precipitation-frequency context only and does not establish urban burden, outfalls, imperviousness, or control performance.

name: Lucas County drought-status context
notes: Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor category context; not groundwater depletion or a soil-moisture field.

name: Maumee low-flow observation context
notes: Low daily mean flow at one gauge; not a watershed-wide low-flow statistic.

name: NOAA Toledo Great Lakes water-level station
notes: Station 9063085; daily means do not capture all short-lived wind setup or seiche variability.

name: Western Lake Erie water-level variability context
notes: Lake-level variability context; not an ocean storm-surge layer.

name: Western Lake Erie shoreline and coastal-flood interface
notes: High/low lake levels, waves, wind setup, and erosion are represented as interfaces, not shoreline predictions.

name: Lake Erie wind setup and seiche interface
notes: Great Lakes wind setup/seiche process; not equated with ocean storm surge.

name: Lake wave, storm, and ice-condition context
notes: Wave, storm, and ice conditions are contextual; no wave-height or ice-risk surface is asserted.

name: Regional severe convective hazard context
notes: Thunderstorm wind, tornado, hail, and flood-related records use the dated 2025 details snapshot aggregated at selected county scale; these are not regional rates or climatology.

name: Selected western-basin county Storm Events records
notes: 2025 selected county event records; event counts are not rates, probabilities, or hazard surfaces.

name: Regional winter hazard context
notes: Extreme cold, snow, ice, and freeze-thaw context; lake-effect snow is not overgeneralized.

name: NWS public warning system
notes: Public warnings and forecasts are control interfaces; warning availability is not hazard absence.

name: USGS streamflow monitoring network
notes: One representative gauge is used; this is not an exhaustive gauge inventory.

name: NOAA CO-OPS Toledo water-level monitoring
notes: CO-OPS station 9063085 provides a local daily-mean water-level record; it is not a complete Great Lakes network or hazard score.

name: U.S. Drought Monitor and drought-information system
notes: Drought categories combine indicators and expert assessment; no groundwater depletion claim.

name: NOAA/NWS precipitation-frequency information
notes: Modeled precipitation-frequency planning context; no observed event, runoff, rate, or future projection is generated here.

name: NOAA NCEI Lucas County climate-series context
notes: NOAA Climate at a Glance county series only; it is not an ACIS station record or a regional climate-data aggregation.

name: NOAA GLERL Great Lakes water-level and ice resources
notes: Monitoring, observation, forecast, and ice resources are distinct products.

name: Generalized developed-system receptor context
notes: Project-inferred generalized receptor context; NWS point metadata establish a forecast/warning interface only and do not directly establish infrastructure or access effects; no asset vulnerability score or sensitive detail.

name: Applied Climate Information System station-data service
notes: ACIS station-data service supports the Toledo Executive Airport observations; it is not a county climate series.

name: NOAA NCEI Storm Events 2025 details snapshot
notes: Dated 2025 details snapshot used for the selected-county event records; counts are not rates or probabilities.
